get.description: Unauthenticated by design — auditors and integrators can verify which signed content bundle the platform is serving (version, signer, signedAt, per-file SHA-256, verification status). No clinical content is returned here.
get.summary: Return the loaded content bundle metadata

get.description: Searches conditions, drugs, scores, antidotes, toxidromes, symptom-triage, pregnancy-lactation, hepatic-dose, reference-ranges, pharmacogenomics, allergy, notifiable, immunization, drug-disease, IV-compatibility, anticoagulant-reversal and procedures in one call. Returns route-addressable hits { domain, slug, title, route, snippet } the UI renders as a single "In VedaMD" result group. Anonymous + read-only; no PHI.
get.summary: Unified search across every content domain in the signed bundle

get.description: Lists every key owned by the calling integrator. Secrets are never returned — only fingerprints + metadata.
get.summary: List API keys

post.description: Issues a new bearer secret. The `secret` field is returned EXACTLY ONCE; the server only stores its HMAC fingerprint. Use the secret as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>` on subsequent calls (FR-313).
Atomically revokes the old key and issues a new secret with the same name, scopes, and environment. Returns both the revoked metadata and the newly created key (secret shown once).

404.description: Unknown key id, foreign integrator, or already revoked.

delete.description: Immediately revokes the key. Any in-flight request with the old secret will be rejected on its next call.

404.description: Unknown key id or foreign integrator.

503.description: The Health Check is not successful

get.description: Unauthenticated by design — discovery is public per CDS Hooks convention.
get.summary: CDS Hooks 1.0 service discovery

post.summary: Invoke a CDS Hooks service (requires cds:evaluate scope)

post.description: Accepts a structured patient context and returns recommendations. See FR-007. Requires the cds:evaluate scope.

get.description: CapabilityStatement-shaped declaration of stateless operation (FR-093). Includes the http://vedamd.io/CapabilityStatement/stateless extension set to true.
get.summary: Stateless CapabilityStatement

get.description: Filters: q (free text over slug/INN/class/trade/RxNorm/ATC), atc (exact ATC), aware (Access|Watch|Reserve), kemlOnly=true.
get.summary: List or search drugs
Get a full drug record by slug

post.description: Body: { slugs: ["paracetamol","warfarin", …] }. Returns every known interaction across the unordered pairs, plus any slugs that did not resolve to a known drug.

Deterministic algorithm over the structured drug record. Refuses to return a mg dose for individualised regimens (e.g. warfarin) or when CrCl falls in a contraindicated band. Always returns a narrative.
post.summary: Calculate a dose for the drug given weight / age / renal function

get.description: Catalogue of every code system in the active content bundle: URI, short id, publisher, license, and concept count.
get.summary: List loaded code systems (FR-040, FR-041)

get.description: Both system URI (e.g. http://loinc.org) and short id (e.g. loinc) are accepted. Returns 404 if the code is not present in the bundle.
get.summary: FHIR $lookup — resolve display + metadata for a (system, code) pair (FR-042)
FHIR $validate-code — assert (system, code) is valid; optional display check (FR-042)

get.description: Ranks matches across the loaded code systems. Optional `systemId` restricts to one (icd-10, loinc, atc, aware).
get.summary: Free-text concept search (FR-044)
FHIR $expand — enumerate the concepts of a value set (FR-042)

get.description: Discovery surface for content-driven CDS. Returns summaries; fetch full guidance by slug.
get.summary: List condition slugs and titles

get.description: Returns presentation, red flags, diagnostics, ordered management steps, and source citations. No patient data is required or accepted at this endpoint.
get.summary: Get structured clinical guidance for a condition

get.description: Filters: domain (e.g. emergency, paediatrics), q (free text over slug/title/CPT). Returns summaries; fetch full guidance by slug.
get.summary: List procedures

get.description: Returns indications, contraindications, equipment, consent notes, ordered steps with safety checks, red flags, post-procedure care, complications and management, and citations.
get.summary: Get structured procedural guidance by slug

get.description: Returns summaries (no full body). Each policy is a clinical SOP or external standard (JCI, ISO, WHO, NICE, company). Policies are integrator-scoped and used by the agentic engine to align recommendations.
get.summary: List uploaded policies / standards for the current integrator

post.description: Accepts either an array of structured `sections` ({title?, body}) or a single `text` body. Source identifies the standard family (JCI, ISO, WHO, NICE, company, other). The body must contain ONLY the integrator's own policy text — never patient identifiers or clinical data.

get.summary: Get a single policy with its sections

get.description: Open catalogue of validated scores (CHA2DS2-VASc, Wells, NEWS2, GCS, CURB-65, etc.). Filters: domain, q (free text over slug/title/abbreviation). Returns summaries; fetch full definition by slug.
get.summary: List clinical scoring tools

get.description: Returns purpose, scored items with points, scoring method, interpretation bands with suggested actions, and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a clinical score definition by slug

get.description: Open CPIC-style catalogue (HLA-B*57:01-abacavir, TPMT/NUDT15-thiopurines, CYP2C19-clopidogrel, DPYD-fluoropyrimidines, G6PD-oxidants, etc.). Filters: gene, drug, q. Returns summaries; fetch full phenotype guidance by slug.
get.summary: List pharmacogenomic gene-drug guidance

get.description: Returns the keyed variant, clinical summary, phenotype-based implications and recommendations (with strength), testing guidance and citations. Reference content only — no patient genotype or identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a gene-drug pharmacogenomic guideline by slug

get.description: Open catalogue of condition-based contraindications and cautions (e.g. NSAID in CKD, metformin in AKI, beta-blocker in asthma). Filters: drug (slug or name), condition (slug or name), severity (contraindicated|caution), q. Returns summaries; fetch full guidance by slug.
get.summary: List drug-disease / drug-condition interactions

get.description: Returns the drug/class, condition, severity, mechanism, recommendation and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a drug-disease interaction by slug

get.description: Open routine immunization schedule (BCG, HepB, pentavalent, OPV/IPV, PCV, rotavirus, measles/MR, HPV, Td, yellow fever, MenA, etc.). Filters: disease, q. Returns summaries; fetch full dose schedule by slug.
get.summary: List WHO EPI immunization schedule entries

get.description: Returns target diseases, dose timings and routes, target population, catch-up guidance, notes and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get an immunization schedule entry by slug

get.description: Open catalogue of drug allergy cross-reactivity, including common myths to dispel (e.g. penicillin-cephalosporin, sulfonamide antibiotic vs diuretics, contrast vs shellfish). Filters: drug (slug or name), risk (high|moderate|low|negligible), q. Returns summaries; fetch full guidance by slug.
get.summary: List drug allergy cross-reactivity entries

get.description: Returns the allergen, what it does (or does not) cross-react with, the risk level, mechanism, recommendation, related drug slugs and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get an allergy cross-reactivity entry by slug

get.description: Open reference of WHO IHR and commonly nationally-notifiable diseases with reporting urgency. Filters: level (ihr-always|ihr-assess|national-immediate|national-routine), q. National statutory lists vary — this is guidance, not the local legal list. Returns summaries; fetch detail by slug.
get.summary: List notifiable diseases (public-health reporting reference)

get.description: Returns the disease, notification level, reporting timeframe, linked condition slug, notes and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a notifiable-disease entry by slug

get.description: Open catalogue of typical adult reference intervals (UCUM units) for labs and vital signs. Filters: category (electrolytes, renal, liver, haematology, vital-signs, etc.), q. Local laboratory/method-specific ranges always take precedence. Returns summaries; fetch full range by slug.
get.summary: List laboratory and vital-sign reference ranges

get.description: Returns the analyte, specimen, low/high bounds, UCUM unit, sex applicability, notes and source caveat. Reference content only — no patient identity or result is processed.
get.summary: Get a reference range by slug

get.description: Open antidote reference (paracetamol->NAC, opioid->naloxone, organophosphate->atropine/pralidoxime, iron->desferrioxamine, digoxin->Fab, methanol->fomepizole, beta-blocker->glucagon, CCB->calcium, LAST->lipid emulsion, cyanide->hydroxocobalamin, etc.). Filters: poison, antidote (name or drug slug), q. Returns summaries; fetch mechanism and dosing by slug.
get.summary: List toxicology antidotes (poison -> antidote)

get.description: Returns the poison, antidote (with drug slug), mechanism, dosing guidance, linked poisoning condition and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get an antidote entry by slug

get.description: Open toxidrome reference: pattern → likely class of poisoning, with management and links to antidote records where applicable. Covers anticholinergic, cholinergic (SLUDGE / organophosphate), opioid, sympathomimetic, sedative-hypnotic, serotonin syndrome, NMS, salicylate. Filters: q (free text), domain. Returns summaries; fetch full details by slug.
get.summary: List toxidromes (poisoning pattern recognition)

get.description: Returns the full pattern: vital signs, exam findings, common causative agents, differential diagnosis, ordered management steps, antidote (where one exists, with link to the antidote record), and red flags. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a toxidrome by slug

get.description: Reversal reference for warfarin, DOACs (apixaban, rivaroxaban, edoxaban, dabigatran), unfractionated heparin, LMWH, fondaparinux, and fibrinolytics (alteplase/tPA). Each record covers life-threatening bleed, urgent surgery, major bleed and supratherapeutic-no-bleed scenarios. Filters: q, drugClass.
get.summary: List anticoagulant reversal protocols

get.description: Returns the full reversal plan: mechanism, urgency-ordered protocols (agent, dose, adjuncts, monitoring, cautions), pitfalls, and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get an anticoagulant reversal protocol by slug

get.description: Curated subset of inpatient IV co-administration pairs — high-mortality / high-volume scenarios from King Guide, ASHP, FDA labelling. Includes the documented-deaths cases (ceftriaxone + calcium in neonates), common ICU mistakes (vasopressor + bicarbonate, vancomycin + pip-tazo) and the permissive defaults (norepinephrine Y-site, dexmedetomidine, metronidazole). Filters: q (free text), drug (name or slug), status (compatible|conditional|incompatible|no-data).
get.summary: List curated IV compatibility pairs (Y-site / additive / syringe)

get.description: Returns the full pair: compatibility status, applicable routes (y-site / additive / syringe), concentration / diluent / time notes, practical alternative when incompatible, and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get an IV compatibility pair by slug

get.description: 2015 FDA PLLR structured-narrative format + LactMed-style lactation detail. Each record is keyed by drug slug and carries a clinical headline + risk summary + clinical considerations + data + reproductive-potential guidance. The retired A/B/C/D/X letter categories are stored for back-compat but should NOT be the primary decision aid. Filters: q (free text), pregnancy / lactation (preferred|acceptable|caution|avoid|contraindicated).
get.summary: List pregnancy + lactation reference records (PLLR format)

get.description: Returns the full PLLR narrative: pregnancy (risk summary, clinical considerations, data, trimester notes), lactation (risk summary, infant exposure data, alternatives), reproductive potential (pregnancy testing, contraception, infertility), and citations.
get.summary: Get a pregnancy + lactation record by slug

get.description: For an integrator that has the drug slug (e.g. from a prescription) and wants the PLLR record directly. Returns 404 if no PLLR record exists for that drug.
get.summary: Reverse lookup by drug slug

get.description: Structured-axis hepatic dose adjustment, mirroring the renal adjustment pattern. Each record carries per-Child-Pugh-class guidance (A=mild, B=moderate, C=severe), mechanism, monitoring, acute-failure considerations, and practical alternatives. Filters: q (free text), decision (use-with-caution|reduce-dose|avoid|contraindicated).
get.summary: List hepatic dose adjustment records (Child-Pugh-banded)

get.description: Returns full Child-Pugh A/B/C guidance, mechanism, monitoring, acute-failure considerations and alternatives.
get.summary: Get a hepatic dose adjustment record by slug

get.description: For an integrator with the drug slug (e.g. from a prescription) — returns the hepatic dose record directly. 404 if no record exists for that drug.
get.summary: Reverse lookup by drug slug

get.description: Backward-chaining differential-diagnosis reference. The clinician asks "what could this be?" — the record returns common / consider / must-not-miss bands, key history + exam, red flags, initial investigations, and disposition. Anonymous; reference-only. Filters: q (free text), population (adult|paediatric|all-ages), domain.
get.summary: List chief complaints with ranked differentials

get.description: Returns the full workup: framing, key history, key exam, ranked differential (common / consider / must-not-miss with discriminating features), red flags, initial investigations, and disposition.
get.summary: Get a chief-complaint workup by slug

get.description: domain ∈ clinical-procedures | bedside-interpretation | preventive-care | growth-development. Filters: category, q. Returns summaries; fetch full sections by slug.
get.summary: List reference cards in a clinical-reference domain

get.description: Returns the full card: summary, titled sections (bullets or ordered steps), red flags and citations. Reference content only — no patient identity is processed.
get.summary: Get a reference card by domain + slug

get.description: Catalogue of plugin / snippet integrations for OpenMRS, OpenEMR, Bahmni, ERPNext, GNU Health, DHIS2, OpenHIM, CommCare, Epic, Cerner / Oracle Health, Allscripts / Veradigm, athenahealth, plus pure-standard targets (HL7 v2, FHIR R4, CDS Hooks 1.0, SMART on FHIR). Filter by category (open-source / proprietary / standard), method (cds-hooks, smart-on-fhir, fhir-rest, rest, hl7v2, webhook, iframe-embed) or free-text query. Returns summaries; fetch detailed snippets + links by slug.
get.summary: List EMR / HMIS integrations VedaMD supports

get.description: Generates a ready-to-import Postman v2.1 collection covering CDS Hooks discovery, every discovered CDS service (POST with realistic sample body), core content endpoints (drugs, conditions, scores, antidotes, ranges, drug-disease, immunization, allergy, notifiable, pgx), the integrations catalogue itself, and a deterministic agentic evaluate example. Bearer auth is pre-configured at the collection level — set the `apiKey` variable to your sandbox or production key after import. Also imports cleanly into Insomnia (via the Postman importer) and Bruno.
get.summary: Download a Postman v2.1 collection for the API

get.description: Same content as GET /:slug, rendered as Markdown. Paste into Confluence / Notion / GitHub README / internal wiki. Plain text — no PHI, no patient data.
get.summary: Get an EMR / HMIS integration as a Markdown document

get.description: Returns description, supported CDS hooks, copy-paste configuration snippets, plugin / documentation links and integrator notes for the requested system.
get.summary: Get an EMR / HMIS integration detail by slug

get.description: Curated mg/kg starting points indexed by (diagnosis, treatment line, medication). Filter by `q` (free-text across diagnosis / line / medication / preparation / remarks) and/or `diagnosis` (exact or substring match). Returns the matching protocol rows plus a sorted unique-diagnosis list for navigation.
get.summary: List weight-based dose protocols

get.description: Lightweight diagnosis index — used by Catalogue / Dose calculator when the full protocol bodies are not needed.
get.summary: Sorted alphabetical list of unique dose-protocol diagnoses

get.description: Single payload powering the /app/tools calculators. Returns paediatric mg/kg dose drugs (paracetamol, ibuprofen, amoxicillin, ceftriaxone, salbutamol, prednisolone, zinc, ORS, cotrimoxazole), the IMCI/APLS vital-sign reference table, and validated scoring systems (NEWS2, qSOFA, Wells PE, CHA₂DS₂-VASc). Calculator math runs client-side; this endpoint ships only the normative reference data.
get.summary: Bedside-calculator reference data — dose drugs + vitals + scoring systems

get.description: Sub-resource — returns just the axes + citation for the requested scoring system (news2, qsofa, wells-pe, cha2ds2-vasc).
get.summary: Get one scoring system by id

get.description: FR-147 — filter by domain, locale, country applicability.
get.summary: Catalog of signed knowledge bundles
Latest bundle metadata for an id

get.description: FR-336 — newest-first ring-buffer view of recent API calls. Bounded by FR-331 (50k entries) and FR-332 (30-day TTL). Field set per FR-333. Scoped to the calling operator's integratorId.
get.summary: Query the bounded integration log
Agentic engine capabilities — LLM provider + SQL connector availability
EHR/HMIS schema-mapper presets (OpenMRS, Bahmni, openEMR, DHIS2 Tracker, FHIR-SQL) — clone + adapt to your local schema, then register as a named query.

post.summary: Agentic CDS evaluation from a structured JSON clinical context
Population / retrospective safety sweep — evaluate up to 100 anonymous contexts; returns per-item results + a critical/warning/info roll-up to triage the most dangerous patients first.
Agentic CDS evaluation from a FHIR R4 Bundle or resource
Agentic CDS evaluation pulling patient data from a configured EHR database

get.summary: List supported LLM providers and whether each is configured.
Get this integrator's LLM preference.

put.summary: Set this integrator's LLM provider and optional model override.

get.description: Returns summaries (no match/card body). Each rule fires at evaluation time when the match block holds.
get.summary: List custom CDS rules for the current integrator

post.description: Define a match block (medications / diagnoses / allergies / labs / patient signals) and a card. The agentic engine merges the resulting cards with the signed bundle + policies.

get.summary: Get a single rule with its full match + card body

delete.summary: Delete a custom rule by id

get.description: Returns the provider identifiers the platform supports (twilio-sms, twilio-whatsapp, africastalking-sms, smtp, whatsapp-business). Used by the UI channel-create form to populate the provider picker.
get.summary: List supported notification providers
List configured notification channels for the calling integrator

post.description: Submit provider + credentials. Credentials are AEAD-encrypted with the integratorId as additional authenticated data and never returned over the API. A channel must be tested via POST /:id/test before it can dispatch real alerts.

get.summary: Get a single channel (summary only — credentials never returned)

patch.summary: Update channel name / recipient / sender / enabled status, OR rotate credentials

post.description: Uses the channel default recipient unless `to` is provided. Sends a short canned message unless `body` is provided. Returns the provider delivery result.
post.summary: Send a test message through this channel

get.summary: List clinical audits for the calling integrator

post.description: Binds a named query (connectionId + namedQueryId) to a set of custom-rule IDs, optional policy IDs to cite, a threshold (absolute count or percentage), and the notification-channel IDs to dispatch on breach.

get.summary: Get a single audit definition by id

patch.summary: Update audit name / rules / policies / threshold / channels

post.description: Executes the configured named query against the integrator-registered connection, evaluates each row against the configured custom rules, cites uploaded policies, computes threshold breach, and dispatches alerts via configured channels when the threshold trips. Returns full structured result (row-level verdicts use anonymous row indices — never patient identifiers).

get.description: Returns metadata only — connection URLs are AEAD-encrypted server-side and never returned over the API.
get.summary: List SQL connections for the calling integrator

post.description: Connection URLs are encrypted on receipt with the integratorId as AAD; the raw value never reaches the database or any application log. The connection is also pushed into the runtime ingestion registry immediately so audits + agentic flows can use it without an app restart.

patch.summary: Update a connection (rotate URL by submitting `url`)

post.summary: Test the connection (issues a SELECT 1 round trip)

get.summary: List named queries for the calling integrator

post.description: SQL is validated read-only at submission (rejects INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/DDL + stacked statements). The mapping is a declarative description of how the result columns map to AgenticClinicalContext (medications, diagnoses, allergies, labs).

Accepts an array of feedback entries per CDS Hooks 1.0 §6. Each entry references a card UUID we minted in a prior /cds-services response. PHI-free — only the outcome + override-reason code + optional comment is persisted.

get.description: Returns total feedback, accepted, overridden, override-rate %, and the top 3 override reason codes for every rule that has feedback. Sorted by total feedback descending. Rules being overridden ≥ 50 % of the time are flagged for editorial review (use this signal to retire false-positive rules).
get.summary: Per-rule feedback aggregation
List feedback entries (latest first) optionally filtered by ruleId

get.description: Returns total / approved / review / draft / deprecated counts for every content domain, plus the overall approved %, and any FR-024 violations (an approved record must carry ≥ 2 reviewers and an approvedAt timestamp). Use this to drive the draft → review → approved governance workflow.
get.summary: Per-domain content review-status coverage + FR-024 audit
Reference home — content counts + chat availability
A–Z index across drugs, conditions + procedures (optionally filter by kind)
Grouped browse. drug: class|aware|keml. condition/procedure: specialty|domain (by clinical domain tags).
Free-text reference search across titles, slugs, classes + tags
Mermaid management flowchart for a condition (deterministic, from signed content)
Mermaid step flowchart for a procedure (safety-check gates highlighted)

post.summary: Drug-interaction NETWORK for a medication list (polypharmacy review) — Mermaid graph with severity-coded edges + a structured interaction list.

get.summary: Single-drug interaction map — the drug + all its interaction partners, severity-coded

post.summary: Dose calculator — weight/age/renal-based, computed from the signed bundle. Refuses + cites when inputs missing or renally contraindicated.
Guarded clinician reference chat — answers ONLY from VedaMD references, cites every claim, refuses anything not covered or non-medical. No patient data; PHI-free.

get.summary: Recent usage events (newest first) for the calling integrator
Usage rollup (by category, endpoint, day, actor type) for the dashboard

info.title: VedaMD API
info.description: Open-source, stateless Clinical Decision Support API. CDS Hooks + REST/JSON. VedaMD never stores patient data — records remain with your EMR.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA-256 fingerprint of the secret. Used for safe display.

name.description: Human-readable label for this key — shown in the dashboard.

scopes.description: Capability scopes granted to this key. Must contain at least one.

environment.description: Which environment this key applies to. Sandbox keys are isolated from prod.

fingerprint.description: HMAC-SHA-256 fingerprint of the secret. Used for safe display.

secret.description: The raw bearer secret. Shown EXACTLY ONCE — copy it now. Use it as `Authorization: Bearer <secret>`.

hook.description: CDS Hook to evaluate against (e.g. medication-prescribe, patient-view).

question.description: Free-text clinical question for the agentic reasoner.
question.example: Is metformin safe to start in this patient?

conversation.description: Prior turns of the conversation, oldest first, EXCLUDING the current `question`. Lets the reasoner keep context across follow-up questions. Anonymous — no patient identifiers. Capped at 40 turns.

mode.description: Pipeline mode. `deterministic` skips LLM; `agentic` requires an LLM provider; `auto` runs LLM if configured, else degrades to deterministic.

minConfidence.description: Drop agentic cards with confidence below this threshold (0..1).

medications.description: Active medications by free-text name, RxNorm/ATC code, or VedaMD slug. Fuzzy-matched.

diagnoses.description: Active diagnoses by name, ICD-10/11, or slug.

signals.description: Free-form additional signals (vitals, observations) passed straight through.

hook.description: CDS Hook to evaluate against (e.g. medication-prescribe, patient-view).

question.description: Free-text clinical question for the agentic reasoner.
question.example: Is metformin safe to start in this patient?

conversation.description: Prior turns of the conversation, oldest first, EXCLUDING the current `question`. Lets the reasoner keep context across follow-up questions. Anonymous — no patient identifiers. Capped at 40 turns.

mode.description: Pipeline mode. `deterministic` skips LLM; `agentic` requires an LLM provider; `auto` runs LLM if configured, else degrades to deterministic.

minConfidence.description: Drop agentic cards with confidence below this threshold (0..1).

medications.description: Active medications by free-text name, RxNorm/ATC code, or VedaMD slug. Fuzzy-matched.

diagnoses.description: Active diagnoses by name, ICD-10/11, or slug.

signals.description: Free-form additional signals (vitals, observations) passed straight through.

id.description: Caller-supplied opaque id to correlate the result (e.g. encounter id). Never logged.

items.description: Up to 100 anonymous clinical contexts. Each is evaluated independently.

resource.description: FHIR R4 Bundle or single resource (Patient, MedicationRequest, Observation, Condition). Parsed by the FHIR adapter.

question.example: Is this safe for this patient?

conversation.description: Prior conversation turns (oldest first), excluding the current question.

connectionId.description: Server-side configured connection id (never a raw connection string from the client).

queryId.description: Server-side named query template id (prevents arbitrary SQL injection).

params.description: Bound parameters for the named query.

hooks.description: Restrict the rule to specific CDS hooks. Empty = all hooks.

eGFRBelow.description: Rule matches if eGFR < this threshold.

labs.description: Array of lab-value clauses (all must hold).

summary.example: Hold metformin if eGFR < 30 — local renal protocol.
